_doc: Kartrummet, fliken Landscape (docs/terrain.md, T3): spakarna, de färdiga landskapen och vyerna. Generatorn är shared/terrain/generate.js (brus, form, terrasser, erosion), marken byggs med shared/terrain/field.js och havet är shared/effects/water.js. Platsen är 256 × 256 m med 0,5 m mellan hörnen. Spakar med "recipe": false (vyn och himlen) sparas inte; sparade landskap hamnar i assets/terrain/<namn>.terrain.json. Texten i appen är på engelska.

params.label: Shape

options.label: Open land
options.help: Only the noise: hills, mountains, plains or highlands

options.label: Island
options.help: Land that falls toward the sea on every side, with an irregular shore

options.label: Archipelago
options.help: Many islands where the low noise rises above the sea, sparser outward

options.label: Coast
options.help: Land in the distance, the sea in front

options.label: Valley
options.help: Two ridges with a wide, winding valley floor between them

options.label: Canyon
options.help: A high plateau cut by a deep, winding gorge with steep walls

params.help: The overall form the noise is laid into

params.label: Seed
params.help: Another seed gives another landscape with the same character

params.label: Height
params.help: The height of the highest land, in metres

params.label: Feature size
params.help: How large the hills are, in metres: small values give many small hills

params.label: Shore
params.help: Where the island's shore runs, as a share of the radius

params.label: Detail levels
params.help: How many finer layers of noise lie on top of each other

params.label: Roughness
params.help: How much the finer layers weigh: low is soft and rounded, high is rough and rocky

params.label: Ridges
params.help: Sharp mountain ridges that branch (ridged noise) instead of round hills

params.label: Swirl
params.help: How much the shapes wind and swirl (domain warp), in metres

params.label: Terraces
params.help: Steps in the land: plateaus and bands of cliffs (0 = none)

params.label: Terrace edges
params.help: How flat the steps are and how sharp their edges

params.label: Rain erosion
params.help: Drops that run downhill, carve gullies and leave sediment in the valleys

params.label: Scree angle
params.help: Slopes steeper than this angle crumble (degrees; 0 = off)

params.label: Sea
params.help: Water at sea level around the land

params.label: Sea level
params.help: The height of the sea, in metres

params.label: Snow line
params.help: Snow above this height, in metres

params.label: Beach
params.help: How high above the sea the sand reaches, in metres

params.label: Cliff angle
params.help: Steeper than this shows bare rock (degrees)

params.label: Grass
params.help: From dry and golden to lush and green

params.label: View

options.label: Shaded
options.help: The land with its ground layers, sun and shadows

options.label: Height
options.help: Colour by height: blue under the sea, green, brown and white up to the top

options.label: Slope
options.help: Colour by steepness: flat is dark, the cliff angle and steeper is red

options.label: Wetness
options.help: Where the rain ran (the erosion drops): dry is light, gullies and valleys blue

options.label: Wireframe
options.help: The triangles, to see the grid and how the diagonals follow the slopes

params.help: What the land shows: shaded, or a debug map

params.label: Weather
params.help: The weather from the Weather tab (ready-made and saved)

params.label: Time of day
params.help: The time of day (the weather's own time is replaced)

params.label: Sun direction
params.help: The compass direction of the sun

params.label: Haze
params.help: How much the air hazes the distance (share of the weather's own haze)

params.label: Exposure
params.help: Overall brightness (on top of the weather's own)
